role.analyst_desc: Reads, and runs read-only SQL over datasets.
role.curator_desc: Everything an editor can do, plus loading new documents in.
role.custom_desc: A capability set you chose by hand.
role.editor_desc: Reads and queries, and can create and edit nodes and dataset rows.
role.owner_desc: Full control, including giving access to other people.
role.reader_desc: Can read what you choose. Nothing else.
